title: PIN Code Input
description: Prevents parcels going to the wrong place by reading the state from an Indian PIN's first digits as you type (offline) and flagging a mismatch with the picked state, catching O typed for 0, wrong lengths, unused prefixes, Army Post codes and ZIP or UK postcodes typed for India, then reading the area back from a pluggable lookup and checking the city, with one-tap fixes.
stops: Parcel sent to the wrong state
